scenes.text: This guide is for organization admins. You own your organization's workspace.

scenes.title: Everything in your workspace
scenes.text: You see and manage everything: programs, voting polls, businesses, wish lists and contributions.

scenes.title: Your team
scenes.text: You manage your team, giving each person access to the items they need, as a viewer or a program admin.

scenes.title: Money
scenes.text: You are the only one who manages the payment fund, withdrawals and refunds, and agrees to the platform fee.
